Cukup sekali. Paling gampang pakai kode:: One-time setup. Easiest way is the code: enter your WhatsApp number and you get 8 characters to type into WhatsApp — no second phone needed to scan a QR.
Tiap ada rilis baru di repo, bot posting: Whenever a repo gets a new release, the bot posts it to your WhatsApp channel or group. More than one repo is fine, separate them with commas. Leave the repo empty if you only want the group guard.
Belum ada repo. Tekan Kelola repo buat n: No repos yet. Tap Manage repos to add one.
Versi beta / RC ikut diposting: Beta / RC versions get posted too
Pas pertama jalan, langsung posting rili: On first run, post the latest release right away
Kirim pesan tes pas setup: Send a test message during setup
Biar ketahuan channel-nya bener: So you know the channel is right
Eksperimental: format Pertanyaan WA belu: Experimental: WhatsApp's Question format isn't publicly documented, so it may not render correctly. Off by default = release posts go out as plain text, which always arrives. Turn on only to try it.
Buat grup yang pakai &quot;Setujui anggo: For groups that use "Approve new members": join requests get approved automatically, EXCEPT people who left or were removed before — they get rejected. Your WhatsApp account must be an admin of that group.
Yang keluar SEBELUM fitur ini nyala ngga: People who left BEFORE this feature was on are unknown to the bot — add their numbers here.
Sesekali bot ngirim potongan lagu lama (: Now and then the bot sends a snippet of an old song (~60 s) plus a caption to the channel. The schedule is randomized like a real mood — not hourly, not spam. Cloudflare finds the song; the phone only downloads a ±1 MB snippet, sends it, and deletes the file right away.
Dikirim ke channel yang sama kayak rilis: Sent to the same channel as releases
Punya project bot Node.js? Upload ZIP-ny: Got a Node.js bot project? Upload its ZIP and this app runs it on the phone — with console, input, and auto restart.
Bot-nya tidur hampir sepanjang waktu, cu: The bot sleeps most of the time and only wakes briefly on schedule. To keep the system (especially Xiaomi) from killing it, allow the two things below.
Nggak perlu buka app habis restart: No need to open the app after a restart
Matiin kalau udah lancar — sedikit lebih: Turn off once everything runs smoothly — saves a bit
Catatan kerja bot. Kalau ada yang aneh,: The bot's work notes. If something looks off, tap Send log.
